advancedArguments.name: subordinates
advancedArguments.description: One or more direct reports (each a name or employee number) to submit this training need application for, e.g. ['John Silva'] or ['000010','000011']. Matches each entry first by exact employee number, then by a case-insensitive substring match against name, against the supervisor's live subordinate list. Omit entirely (or pass an empty array) if you don't already know who this is for, or the supervisor asks 'who are my subordinates?' - the tool returns status LISTED with eligibleSubordinates and submits nothing, so this is always safe to call on its own. Once the supervisor has picked, call this tool again with subordinates set to their exact name(s) or employee number(s) - this is checked before everything else that follows, so call it with ONLY subordinates (existingNeedName/newNeedName and the narrative fields all omitted) to validate them first before ever asking about the need itself. If any entry doesn't match exactly one subordinate, the tool returns NOT_SUBORDINATE or AMBIGUOUS (whichever applies) listing every problem entry plus eligibleSubordinates - fix all of them before ever asking about the need itself or narrative fields.

advancedArguments.name: existingNeedName
advancedArguments.description: The name (or partial name) of an already-existing training need category to attach this application to, e.g. 'Database & Data Management' - matches case-insensitively against the category list from getSupervisorTrainingNeeds' existingNeedCategories. Use this when the subordinate's need matches a category already on file (UAC 3.2) rather than describing something new. If more than one category matches, the tool returns status AMBIGUOUS with the candidates - ask which one and retry with the exact name. Either existingNeedName or newNeedName must be provided, not both. Only required once every named subordinate is already confirmed valid - do not collect or pass this on the subordinates-only validation call.

advancedArguments.name: newNeedDescription

advancedArguments.name: objective
advancedArguments.description: The objective of this training need. There is no goal-linking option here (confirmed live: a real multi-subordinate submission sent IsGoalObject false with no ongoing-goals data at all) - always free text, unlike the self-application tool's goalTitle alternative. Whether this is mandatory is a per-client Training & Development configuration setting (IsObjectiveMandatory) and can change between orgs - do not assume it's required and do not ask the supervisor for it upfront. Call this tool with whatever is known once every named subordinate is confirmed valid; if ValidateNeedApplication rejects the submission with 'Please specify the objective.', that confirms it's mandatory for this org - ask for it then and call this tool again with the same arguments plus objective filled in.

advancedArguments.name: confirmed
advancedArguments.description: Set true only after the supervisor has reviewed a summary of this exact application (subordinates, need, objective, relevance to job, benefits, attachments) and explicitly agreed to submit it. Leave unset/false on the first call - the tool returns status CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with a preview and the server's own confirmation prompt (mirrors the real form's 'Are you sure you want to submit this training need?' dialog, shown right before Save) instead of submitting anything. Nothing is uploaded, validated, or saved until this is true. Call this tool again with confirmed:true and the exact same arguments once the supervisor agrees.
